data.name: Carbon Gold
data.description: Carbon Gold is a UK-based biochar supplier founded in 2007 and headquartered in Bristol, selling Soil Association-approved biochar-enriched composts, fertilisers and tree-care products to commercial growers, landscapers and (via a 2024 Westland Horticulture partnership) home gardeners. The company is B-Corp certified, holds a Royal Warrant, and positions biochar as a negative-emissions soil amendment.
